deficits.evidence: no purpose-built sidewalk, people walking on dirt slope
deficits.suggestion: Construct a paved sidewalk on the left side of the road to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

deficits.evidence: uneven dirt surface and debris on the informal path
deficits.suggestion: Level and pave the informal path on the right side to remove trip hazards.

deficits.evidence: pedestrians present and residential/commercial buildings on both sides but no designated crossing
deficits.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing to provide a safe point for people to cross the road.

ratings.reason: The left side consists of a dirt slope with no paved footway, and there is ample space for construction.
The right side shows an unpaved, uneven dirt shoulder that poses trip hazards.
There are no marked crossings visible despite the presence of residential buildings and pedestrians.
